literal_meaning: এক বা অর্ধেকটা (one or half a thing)
figurative_meaning_bn: খুব অল্পসংখ্যক; একটা বা বড়জোর দুটো
figurative_meaning_en: Very few in number; one or at most two
example_sentences_in_bangla: এক আধটা ভুল তো সবারই হয়।
example_sentences_in_english: Everyone makes one or two mistakes.
Give me one or two chances.
note: This idiom is widely used in spoken Bengali to downplay quantity.
